plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 48 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.43201, -117.67271, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 140 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: elk, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the edge of the 2023 burn (410 m W: grass and shrubs) at first and last light; in September listen for bugling bulls. Keep the wind in your face (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-16, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-elk-drive-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-16: about 1,160 hunter days a year for elk (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.64 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 2 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
